title: Sweep LR warmdown length (WARMDOWN_RATIO 0.5 -> 0.8)
description: Changed WARMDOWN_RATIO from 0.5 to 0.8, giving a longer/gentler linear LR cooldown (starts at progress=0.2 instead of 0.5) within the same fixed 5-minute budget; all else unchanged from DEPTH=10 baseline.
reflection: val_bpb 1.005063, worse than baseline 1.002279. A longer warmdown window hurt rather than helped -- likely because it shrinks the effective high-LR training phase too much for this short 5-minute budget, costing more in reduced high-LR optimization time than it gains in settling quality. This suggests the original WARMDOWN_RATIO=0.5 was already close to optimal, or if anything a *shorter* warmdown (e.g. 0.3) might be worth testing next, not a longer one.
